headline: How Cloudflare auto-mitigated a world record 3.8 Tbps DDoS attack
description: Cloudflare’s DDoS defenses have automatically and successfully detected and mitigated a 3.8 terabit per second DDoS attack — the largest attack on record — as part of a month-long campaign of over a hundred hyper-volumetric L3/4 DDoS attacks.
